source: Synthetic local-only CMS envelopes produced with OpenSSL 3.5.5 on the MiniPC on 2026-10-21 (openssl req -x509 RSA-2048 self-signed + openssl cms -sign -binary -nodetach -outform DER/PEM). No third-party personal data, no real signature, zero upload.

tampered.opensslOutcome: CMS_verify: content verify error (verification failure) while the eContent is still written in full

refuse: content that is not a SignedData envelope (P7M_CONTENT_INFO)
notVerified: digest and signature of every SignerInfo
certificate chain, trust anchor and eIDAS qualification
CRL/OCSP freshness, timestamp and validity at signing time
any claim of legal or authentic status
